fusions.name: Cap Burst
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 4 damage and is [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max +50%).

fusions.name: Rot Root
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 10 seconds. Stingers fight beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Compost Cycle
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted expires, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
